behavior.externalPermissionRequired: source.download.allowed must explicitly equal true; listening-only verified/ALEA sources produce a clear refusal before any media request.
behavior.externalDownloadRoute: Only Audius, ASCII alphanumeric ID and exact https://api.audius.co/v1/tracks/{id}/stream are accepted. No URL from JSON or arbitrary verified-provider URL can be downloaded.
behavior.conditionalSha256: Only if the source advertises a checksum, read the bounded cached file into RAM for WebCrypto and compare before committing metadata. Normal transfers have no additional full-file JS array buffer.
behavior.durationAndTailValidation: External copies must have the expected full duration within 3 seconds and yield decodable data after seeking to the final quarter second; metadata alone cannot mark a preview or truncated file done.

serviceWorker.readableCachedAudio: Answers a normal local request with byte length and Accept-Ranges, and single valid byte requests with 206, Content-Range and Content-Length. Uses local cached Blob slices; never fetches remote audio.

liveProof.runtime: Desktop Chrome, real Audius metadata/media, static compiled PWA worker on temporary loopback QA origin, production download manager/CacheStorage/IDB. Temporary QA HTTP server was closed; no runtime product server was added.
